result.title: Detection Is Not the Finish Line: Multiscale Decoding and Constraint-Aware Global Association for Multi-Camera 3D Tracking
result.summary: A query-based multi-view 3D detector can transfer well to a new calibrated camera network and still produce badly fragmented tracks: on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 validation set, the frozen Sparse4D detector behind the official challenge winner splits each Person identity into a median of eight fragments, and half of the gaps between fragments exceed the horizon of a causal tracker. We show that most of the remaining headroom of such a system lies after detection. Keeping the public detector frozen, we add (i) class-wise source selection between two input scales, which recovers small and distant people from a 0.75x pass while leaving large objects at the scale the detector was trained for; (ii) a geometry-to-appearance bridge that projects every 3D box into all calibrated views, matches it to 2D person detections, and aggregates robust track-level re-identification descriptors; and (iii) constraint-aware consolidation, which combines a causal short-gap stitch with offline centroid-linkage clustering under two hard constraints, temporal exclusion and metric 3D reachability, plus class-aware long-gap stitching for rigid objects. Every association stage changes object identities only. On the challenge evaluation server the system scores 62.3947 3D HOTA (DetA 57.4501, AssA 56.8131, LocA 80.1272), first on the general leaderboard snapshot of 30 October 2026 (second at the time of writing, after a competitor's detector update) and 5.63 points above our reproduction of the official winner; the constrained association stage alone contributes +3.73 HOTA through a +5.49 AssA gain at unchanged DetA. Controlled fixed-box validation studies, a constraint ablation, sensitivity curves, and a catalogue of negative results support the design.

AI.brief_summary: 在冻结的 Sparse4D 多视角检测器之上，为多摄像头 3D 跟踪加入类别的多尺度输入源选择、把 3D 框投影到各标定视角匹配 2D 行人检测以聚合轨迹级 re-ID 描述子，以及带时间排斥与 3D 可达性硬约束的因果短间隙拼接加离线聚类，用于缓解身份碎片化。
AI.relevance_reason: 多尺度证据选择与「几何投影匹配 2D 检测再聚合描述子」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节筛选、证据与内部状态绑定提供可核查线索；但论文主体是检测后关联与身份整理工程，与 latent 推理状态的生成和使用距离较远。
